title: El Paella de Patron
notes: BLVD's breakfast gets a fried sunnyside up egg!

ingredientSections.heading: Paella
items: Optional proteins: Chorizo, Chicken, Smoked pork, Mussels, Clams, Prawns

methodSections.heading: Preparing the Rice
steps: Sweat finely diced onion and garlic in the olive oil on medium-high in a large thick-bottomed pot until translucent. Add the rice to the onions and toast slightly and then add the saffron and stir for 30 seconds more.
Slowly add the stock 1 cup at a time. Only add enough to wet the bottom of the pot so that the rice moves easily.
Keep stirring in stock cup by cup until rice is just passed al dente. You should have a very slight firmness when biting into a grain.

In a parchment-lined tray, pour the rice and flatten on tray allowing it to finish steaming. Store uncovered in refrigerator for a minimum of 24 hours. This is an integral step because the rice will dry slightly yielding a crispier product.

methodSections.heading: Paella
steps: The next day, heat oil in a heavy-bottom skillet or pan until very hot. Add desired proteins and sauté until half cooked.
Add the dried rice and a generous knob of butter and sauté until rice becomes golden and crisp, and the proteins are cooked. Before plating, toss in green peas and serve.
